name: sweety
description: Sweety – Blood Glucose Tracker. Commands for running the whole project from this folder.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix server run worker:dev" "npm --prefix clientSide run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix clientSide test
